summary: Critical Vapor Cloud Explosion at T-101 (LPG). Severe blast overpressure and thermal flux threaten adjacent Propane sphere T-102 (estimated 72% escalation probability within 165s). West evacuation route is compromised.

hazardZones.description: Total structural destruction, heavy equipment displacement, 100% human lethality.
Moderate building damage, steel frame distortion, ruptured unreinforced walls.
100% lethality in 1 min, severe process equipment damage and instantaneous secondary ignition.

affectedAssets.damageSummary: High thermal flux and overpressure on sphere shell; blast wall provides estimated 35% shielding.

affectedAssets.name: North Perimeter Main Gate
affectedAssets.damageSummary: Fully intact and operational for personnel egress.

dominoPropagation.riskContribution: Model estimate: Thermal radiation from T-101 pool fire heats unwetted shell plates of T-102 leading to secondary BLEVE.

escapeRoutesAssessment.name: West Perimeter Evacuation Path
escapeRoutesAssessment.recommendation: DO NOT USE. Route passes directly through the 20 kPa blast zone and downwind flame radiation cone.

escapeRoutesAssessment.name: North Gate Evacuation Corridor
escapeRoutesAssessment.recommendation: RECOMMENDED EVACUATION ROUTE. Protected by distance and control building shielding.

recommendedApproachDirection.rationale: Direct upwind / crosswind approach from West-Northwest provides clean air corridor away from downwind thermal plume and projectile trajectory.
